ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 15, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, November 29, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
